content: WHO WE ARE At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide. Our Ambition: To build the world's most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like. Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high growth environment, join us and be part of a team that's transforming the way the world pays. ABOUT THE ROLE Trustly guarantees payments in North America. This role leads fraud detection and response in Risk Operations, from finding emerging fraud patterns to stopping them with short-term rules. It also supports the team’s compliance reporting and collections work. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Lead detection and investigation of fraud attacks across return alerts, anomaly alerts and transaction monitoring, and document the modus operandi (MO) of each attack. - Write, backtest and deploy short-term fraud rules for emerging patterns, monitor their performance, and brief segment risk managers on rule changes and their effect on approval rate. - Hand emerging patterns to Risk & Fraud Analytics and Data Science for long-term rule and model changes, and own fraud labeling of returned transactions. - Automate manual detection and investigation work, including with AI tools. - Support compliance reporting, including NACHA return rate monitoring, AML alert reviews and evidence for suspicious activity reports. - Support collections workflows, including account reviews before unblocking, agency and legal file submissions, and reconciliation of recovered payments. - Mentor and train analysts, and review their cases and rules. - Track and report fraud KPIs: time to detect, time to mitigate, alert hit rate, attack recall and net savings. About the role The fraud landscape is rapidly evolving, and our team plays a pivotal role in keeping Trustly safe while ensuring friction-free transactions for legitimate users. We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented Fraud Analyst to join our growing hub in Lisbon. In this role, you will investigate end-to-end fraud claims, dissect first-party and third-party fraud patterns, and lead complex liability claim workflows under UK regulatory frameworks. Working with data query templates and manual extraction tools, you will analyze transaction behaviors, interact directly with external partner banks and merchants, and label crucial data points to continuously strengthen our automated rule sets and machine learning systems. What you’ll do - Independently investigate fraud claims received from partner banks and merchants, assessing incident validity and identifying underlying fraud vectors. - Lead end-to-end investigations on UK legislative liability claims where Trustly holds shared liability, ensuring fair and timely resolution outcomes. - Communicate and collaborate directly with external financial institutions, partner banks, and merchants to gather evidence, resolve disputes, and clarify fraud findings. - Accurately mark and categorize transaction datasets to retrain our automated fraud rules and machine learning models. - Conduct proactive undetected fraud monitoring and analysis across transaction streams using internal extraction tools and SQL query templates. - Collaborate closely with team members across Lisbon and Stockholm to share typologies, refine operational workflows, and improve team playbooks.
